analysis:
The code snippet overrides onCreateOptionsMenu. The flow: inflate menu resource, get a drawable from resources, set color filter on drawable, find a menu item by ID and set its icon, return true. Potential runtime exceptions: 
- getMenuInflater().inflate() and getResources().getDrawable() may throw Resources.NotFoundException (runtime) if the resource IDs are invalid or missing. 
- menu.findItem() returns null if the item ID is not found; calling setIcon on null throws NullPointerException. 
- shareIcon.setColorFilter() is unlikely to throw runtime exceptions. These exceptions are typically programming errors (missing resources or menu configuration) and are not caught in standard Android development; they are left to crash the app to signal the bug. Therefore, no runtime exception handling is required within this snippet.
